title: Edgeware Listing on Coinstore
body:
Hi!

My name is Amit. I am working as a Global Partnership & Strategic Growth Lead APAC & EU at Coinstore .

Coinstore is a Singapore-based CEX that started during the year 2020.  Coinstore has a total of 4 Million registered users & with a daily trading volume that varies between 680 Million + in 24 hours. We have a daily active user of around 500K from 175 countries. Coinstore is one of the top exchanges as far as the South East Asian market is concerned. South East Asian market is more crypto-centric compared to any other continent. However, Coinstore is rapidly expanding in Europe & we’re expecting to be one of the top exchanges in Europe by Q1 2024. Coinstore has recently signed up an MOU with the Indonesian government to facilitate international crypto projects in the Indonesian market without having any compliance issues. We’re the first international crypto exchange to have such a kind of honor. Recently, we have signed an MOU with Philippines Government to facilitate international crypto projects into their market. 

Our Expansion in South East Asia

Coinstore found out that South East Asian market was untapped by other big CEXS & always believed that it has the highest potential in the crypto space considering the community believes in cryptocurrency as their future currency. In the South East Asian market, compliance rules are becoming favorable to the crypto community. As per the Indonesian trade ministry data, there are 14 Million crypto active wallets which are present currently in the Indonesian market and they’re expecting the number to be increased substantially to 30 Million by the end of Q4 2023. Since Coinstore has signed an MOU with the Indonesian government we will be focusing more on the Indonesian market by doing localized marketing. Another milestone is, Coinstore has acquired around 1 million users after we signed an MOU with the government of Indonesia. This is one of the examples of how we’re focusing country-wise.
